body:
The maintainer asked for this in chat on 2026-11-22, in his own words:

> issue; enhancement; support for tapered tooling like ball mills, roundover bits and similar, router style tooling.

Part of #3351. Refs #3351. This is sub-issue 1 of the plan in the research comments of #3351 (option C, the hybrid shape model).

## What to do

Add one internal shape type in `camcraft-tools`: the tool meridian. It is the cutting outline `rho(z)`, tip up, made of lines and circular arcs. All consumers read the tool shape through it in later sub-issues.

1. A new module (for example `crates/tools/src/meridian.rs`, under 400 lines). It holds the meridian type and `Tool::meridian()`. Reuse the point form of `SpunProfile` (`crates/tools/src/spun.rs`: `z`, `r`, signed `arc`).
2. `Tool::meridian()` gives the meridian of each existing mill kind from its numbers: `EndMill`, `BallNose`, `BullNose`, `Taper`, `Drill`, and the undercut heads of #1444 (`Lollipop`, `Dovetail`, `TSlot`, `Keyseat`). It agrees with `Tool::profile` (`crates/tools/src/tools.rs:387-465`) on the cutting band.
3. A split of the meridian into convex atoms:
   - a straight segment gives a frustum (each slope);
   - an arc that bulges away from the axis gives a torus zone;
   - an arc that bulges toward the axis gives chord frusta (outer bound) or tangent frusta (inner bound), with a sag limit as a parameter.
4. Each atom carries a flag: cutting, or non-cutting (a pilot bearing band).
5. Degenerate input (a zero-length segment, a negative radius, a non-finite value, an arc that does not fit its chord) gives a named error. It never panics.

No consumer changes in this issue. No toolpath, simulation or check changes.

## Rules

- The geometry is from elementary plane geometry (chord sag `R (1 - cos(theta / 2))`) and convexity (Boyd and Vandenberghe, Convex Optimization, 3.2.5). Each module has its provenance line. No HSMWorks material.
- `effort:max`: a new geometry algorithm and the shape law that the gouge checks will read.

## Done means

- `Tool::meridian()` exists for each mill kind listed above.
- Tests pin, for each existing kind, that its convex atoms are the same solids that `Cutter::atoms` (`crates/sim/src/verify/probe.rs:180-230`) builds today, within 1e-9 mm.
- Tests pin the outer and inner bounds of a concave arc: the outer union contains the arc, the inner union stays inside it, and each sag is under the limit.
- Tests pin a named error for each degenerate input.
